grammar.title: 间接引语
grammar.explanation: 间接引语转述他人话语时，需注意时态呼应（主句过去时，从句时态前移）、人称变化、时间地点状语变化。
grammar.structure: 主语 + said/told + (that) + 宾语从句

examples.sentence: He said, "I am tired." → He said (that) he was tired.
examples.translation: 他说：「我累了。」→ 他说他累了。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思听力中常出现间接引语转述，注意时态和人称的变化。

questions: When do you usually get up?
What part of the day do you like most?
Has your routine changed much recently?
What would you like to change about your routine?
speaking.sampleAnswer: I'm admittedly not a morning person, so I typically drag myself out of bed around 7:30. My favorite part of the day is undeniably the evening, when I can finally unwind after a long day and devote time to reading or pursuing personal projects. My routine has shifted considerably in recent months—I used to commute to an office, but now I work remotely, which has given me more flexibility but also blurred the boundaries between work and leisure. If I could change one thing, I would wake up earlier to exercise; I know it would boost my energy levels, but breaking the habit of late nights has proven challenging.
speaking.tips: 描述日常时使用频率副词，体现自然流畅。
